purpose: Fresh one-shot successor with identical frozen science after a solver-free technical preflight failure; high-photon result-blind paired comparison of the Taylor baseline aerosol vertical profile against one pre-existing independently retrieved CAMS vertical-extinction proxy, plus empirical between-seed MC errors and wide-SQM versus true-zenith operator diagnostic.

profileCase.classification: independently retrieved proxy vertical extinction profile; not exact measured atmosphere
profileCase.normalization: vertical shape normalized on the exact Taylor atmosphere grid; total AOD550 remains the per-row frozen Taylor value

regions.note: row26 is secondary_moon_background_sensitive for absolute Taylor agreement, but remains valid for paired numerical profile sensitivity/operator calculation

mystic.mcRadStdUse: diagnostic file retained by MYSTIC internally but never used as the empirical between-seed uncertainty estimator

fixedBetweenCases.atmosphereFamily: AFGL US standard as frozen in Taylor v1
fixedBetweenCases.spectralPhaseOpticalPropertyFamily: aerosol_default; only vertical tau allocation differs

precisionThresholdsMag.actionOnFailure: Do not reinterpret noisy values as physical. Open a fresh reviewed continuation identity with more photons and/or additional independent pairs.

analysis.empiricalUncertainty: sample SD across six independent seed pairs; SE=SD/sqrt(6); paired delta uses profile-minus-baseline within each CRN pair
analysis.regionRealnessCriterion: two-sided 95% Student-t CI across six pair-level region means excludes zero
analysis.agreementMetric: change in absolute observed-minus-model residual, profile minus baseline; no fit

koomenDiagnostic.definition: full original-wide-SQM synthetic magnitude minus true zenith-direction synthetic magnitude at the same timestamp
